attributes.description: One bar per STEP, clustered side by side at each time bucket, ordered by when each step first fired so the cluster reads left-to-right in pipeline order. The order is derived from the data, never from a hardcoded step list, so a different workflow orders itself.
attributes.title: Step outcomes over time

attributes.description: Completed / Failed / Cancelled over the same selection, and WHICH STEPS produced each. The inner ring is the outcome, the outer the steps that reached it. Cancelled is coloured distinctly from Failed on purpose: a policy rejection and a defect send an operator to different places.
attributes.title: Outcome distribution

attributes.description: One donut per (processor, whitelist) pair in the selected workflow -- two processors holding one list each and one processor holding two lists both draw two. The title names whose list it is; inside, the inner ring is the verdict and the outer the value the list was asked about. A rejection here IS the Cancelled slice below, one step later.
